key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 and advised immediate evacuation of coastal areas.
Evacuations took place in coastal communities following the alert.
No significant tsunami wave appeared and no damages were observed.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred in the Philippine Trench east of the southern tip of the Province of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3, meaning immediate evacuation.
This is most evident for parts of Guiuan where the travel time of the wave was calculated to be around 10 minutes; however, no significant wave appeared and no damages were observed.
missing_information: Specific damage/injury figures are not applicable; report notes no damages.
Broader list of directly affected settlements beyond Guiuan not fully detailed.
